purpose: Merge the validated stage-16 SteamDB lookup ledger into the persistent history cache exactly once, migrate legacy schema 1 entries to canonical writer schema 2, and repair metadata without inventing historical values.

merge_rules.confirmed_min: persist only a positive exact KZT historical minimum from the validated lookup ledger
merge_rules.unavailable_exact_history: persist status unavailable_exact_history only when stage 16 marks the result persistable and source-reached evidence is present
merge_rules.existing_and_new_key: validated stage-16 result replaces the previous entry for that exact key
merge_rules.entry_count: must equal actual len(entries) after merge

pass_requires: cache is written at most once if changed
all 51 stage-16 resolutions are represented in schema-2 cache
legacy entries are migrated without changing their historical values
